_meta.name: English
app.title: Attendant Service
app.description: Planning and operation of the attendant service at conventions and assemblies.
brand.name: Attendants
brand.subtitle: Event administration
auth.loginIntro: Sign in to plan and operate the attendant service.
auth.privacy: Personal data is processed only for event administration.
auth.visualBody: Plan staffing, track attendance, and stay in control throughout the event.
accountSetup.title: Create your password
accountSetup.intro: Choose a strong password for your system administrator account.
accountSetup.missingToken: The activation code is missing. Open the complete link from the email again.
accountSetup.completeBody: You can now sign in as system administrator.
setup.adminMissingBody: Public registration is securely disabled. The first administrator account is created directly in the separate database.
setup.nextStepBody: Provide the desired name and email address to the person installing the system.
eventType.label: Event type
home.foundationBody: The foundation is ready. When the next phase opens, you can create basic data and begin planning.
home.createEventReady: Choose a date and venue, configure shifts, and save the event in a few steps.
home.eventFoundationBody: Create the next event, reuse venues, and keep every shift together.
home.createEventLater: The creation wizard will be enabled in phase 3 when the basic setup is ready.
home.nextEventBody: The next event will appear here with direct access to the duty plan and control panel.
home.secureLoginBody: Separate sessions and protection against misuse.
home.roleAccessBody: Administrator and attendant overseer permissions are enforced by the server.
home.eventTypesBody: Circuit assemblies and regional conventions are separated from the start.
users.title: Users
users.intro: Create accounts and decide which event types each person can administer.
users.newAccountBody: The user can be deactivated later without deleting their history.
users.name: Name
users.passwordHint: At least 12 characters containing letters and numbers.
users.emptyPassword: Leave the password field empty to keep the current password.
settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Choose your language and personal display settings.
settings.languageBody: The language is used in menus, forms, messages, and future notifications.
settings.languageSaved: The language has been changed to {{language}}.
base.title: Basic setup
base.intro: Manage attendants, posts, contacts, and default times for {{type}}.
base.emptyGuards: No attendants have been created yet.
base.emptyPosts: No attendant posts have been created yet.
base.emptyContacts: No contacts have been created yet.
base.defaultsBody: These values are suggested automatically when a new event is created, but they can always be changed.
base.saved: The default settings have been saved.
base.overviewIntro: Choose the area you want to manage for {{type}}.
base.guardsIntro: Create and maintain the people who can be assigned to the duty plan.
base.postsIntro: Create post numbers and descriptions that can be reused for future events.
base.contactsIntro: Collect important phone numbers that must be quick to find during the event.
base.defaultsIntro: Choose the times and number of shifts the system should suggest for new events.
base.separateDataNotice: Records apply only to the selected event type.
event.listIntro: Create new events and open planning for upcoming and previous events.
event.noUpcoming: No upcoming events have been created yet.
event.historyIntro: Completed and closed events are shown here.
event.wizardIntro: Details are saved after each step so you can safely continue later.
event.dateVenueIntro: The {{type}} automatically gets the correct duration and name.
event.circuitDuration: The circuit event lasts one day.
event.regionalDuration: The regional event lasts three consecutive days.
event.venueSavedHint: Previous venues can be reused for future events.
event.shiftsIntro: When you change a boundary between two shifts, the following shift adjusts automatically.
event.reviewIntro: Everything is saved. Review the setup before opening the event for further planning.
event.createdBody: The basic setup is ready, and you can continue with duty planning.
planning.intro: Assign attendants to posts and shifts. Every change is saved immediately.
planning.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, phone, or note
planning.disableIntro: Choose whether to disable the attendant for this event only or indefinitely.
planning.disableConfirm: The attendant has {{count}} assigned shifts. They will be removed if you continue. Continue?
planning.guardEnabled: The attendant can be selected again.
planning.disabledForEvent: The attendant is disabled for this event.
planning.reasonPost: Cannot be assigned to this post
planning.assignedSameDayCount: Already assigned to {{count}} shifts on this day
planning.noPostsTitle: No posts in the duty plan
planning.noPostsBody: Create active posts in the basic setup, then reopen the duty plan.
planning.availabilityEmptyHint: An empty time range or no selected days means the person is available without that restriction.
planning.allowedPostsHint: If no posts are selected, the attendant can be assigned to every post.
dashboard.title: Event control
dashboard.noContacts: No contacts are stored for this event.
dashboard.checkedIn: The attendant has been checked in.
dashboard.checkedOut: The attendant has been checked out.
checkin.prepareBody: Create a secure entry page and personal codes for every attendant in the duty plan.
checkin.regenerateConfirm: All current codes will stop working. Create new codes?
checkin.codesReadyBody: Save or share the codes now. For security, they cannot be retrieved later; new ones must be created instead.
checkin.publicIntro: Enter your personal code and choose whether you are arriving or leaving.
checkin.privacy: The registration stores the time of arrival or departure.
checkin.successInBody: Welcome, {{name}}. Your arrival has been recorded.
checkin.successOutBody: Thank you, {{name}}. Your departure has been recorded.
checkin.noHistory: No arrivals or departures have been recorded yet.
counting.noRounds: No counting rounds have been created yet.
counting.dashboardIntro: Follow every section and the total without reloading the page.
errors.invalid_counting_round: Enter a valid counting time and at least one section.
errors.invalid_counting_section: Every section needs a name and an active responsible attendant.
errors.counting_link_not_found: The counting link is invalid or has been revoked.
errors.counting_changed: The count was changed elsewhere. Reload the page and verify the number.
communications.title: Direct messages
communications.intro: Send the same message separately to one or more selected attendants.
communications.oneWayTitle: Replies are not processed by the system
communications.oneWayBody: Each recipient gets an individual message. The system creates no group and does not receive or display inbound replies.
communications.noRecipients: No attendants with a phone number are assigned in the duty plan.
communications.noMessages: No broadcasts have been recorded yet.
communications.blocked: The messages were not sent. The official messaging channel is not configured yet.
alarm.notEmergencyReplacement: Does not replace official emergency procedures or emergency calls.
alarm.deliveryWarning: The message will be sent individually to the selected people when the official channel is ready.
alarm.confirm: I confirm that the alarm should be sent to the selected recipients.
alarm.sent: The alarm messages were sent individually.
alarm.blocked: The alarm was logged, but messages were not sent because the channel is not configured.
